about: The cases both sides of a history filter are tested against (DESIGN.md sections 29.5, 30, 31.12, 32 and 33): backend/tests/test_runfilter.py runs them through the server's SQL, frontend/src/history.test.ts through the page's matches(). Runs are listed newest first, as the history shows them; mode is the runs table's mode (generate and edit are the image tab, music the music tab, vector the vector tab: runs l, m, n and o are the vector runs, and the items of a vector run are its versions, so items_in_bin of o is a version in the bin; speech the speech tab: runs p, q and r are readings, which are kept from the start because they never expire (DESIGN.md section 38.8) and have nothing of their own to put in the bin); deleted means the run is in the bin; items_in_bin is how many of its own pictures (or tracks, for a music run) are in the bin while the run is not (a picture of a run in the bin is not listed or counted on its own). project is the project the run is filed in, or null (a filed run is always kept, as the studio makes it). A filter's deleted is false (the history, the default), true (the Deleted view: runs in the bin and runs that have something in it) or null (either); its project is null (any), "none" (runs in no project) or a project's id. counts are what GET /api/runs/counts answers: for the bin, THINGS: each run in it and each picture or track in it of a run that is in the history; deleted_items is the second part alone. family, on a run, is the letter of the run that is the first of its family (a variation made from it: DESIGN.md section 43.4), or absent for a run that is in no family or is the first of one; only picture runs (generate and edit) have one. Runs g, e, h and k are variations of b (h and k are in the bin; k also has a picture of its own in the bin) and f is a variation of a. A filter's family is absent (any run), or the letter of a first run: the view shows that run and every run made from it, as far as the rest of the filter lets them be shown.

cases.name: no filter shows the history, without the bin
kept shows the kept runs of the history, whatever their state or kind
not kept shows the rest of the history
deleted shows the bin, kept or not
kept and deleted shows what is kept in the bin
either shows everything
a project shows the runs filed in it, of the history, whatever their kind
another project shows only its own runs
none shows the runs that are in no project, of the history
a project in the bin shows the runs that were filed in it when they were deleted
none in the bin shows the deleted runs that were in no project
a project, bin or history, shows all its runs
a project and kept: every filed run is kept
a project and not kept is empty: a filed run is always kept
a project that does not exist shows nothing, and is not an error
the bin also shows a run that is in the history but has a picture or a track of its own in it
a run with a picture in the bin is still in the history, and so is not missing from it
a project's bin shows its runs that are in it and those with something in it
none in the bin shows the runs with something in the bin that are in no project
kept and deleted: a kept run with a track in the bin is there
a reading is kept from the start, so Kept lists one that is in no project and not-kept never does
a family shows its first run and what was made from it, of the history
another family shows only its own runs
a family in the bin shows its runs that are in it and those with something in it
a family, bin or history, shows all of it
a family and kept narrows within the family: none of this one is kept
a family and kept narrows within the family: all of this one is
a family and a project narrows within the family
a family nobody is in shows nothing, and is not an error
